items.title: Allen Toussaint Interview, 1979-03-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] After you got out of the Army, didn't the All For One group get together with Harold and Batiste? ... [INTERVIEWEE] After, after. Yeah. I don't know whether it was, I think it was a little before.

ctx.x: Right. Right. Right. Actually, in the writing of Whipped Cream, one thing that did make Whipped Cream a bit unique from the other tunes right in that same year of instrumentals, I did have Al Hurt in mind after he had did Java. I hadn't thought of Java for a trumpet or anything. And Al Hurt did inspire a lot of songs. It's easier to write what Al Hurt in mind. You can write forever. It's like writing for Aaron Neville's Iron Man Thomas. You can write for them without stopping.
After you got out of the Army, didn't the All For One group get together with Harold and Batiste? Was that pretty soon after that?
After, after. Yeah. I don't know whether it was, I think it was a little before.
